claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellCommandRestriction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Command spell cast through this wand is restricted to the 'flee' or 'grovel' option only. The current grant_spell_access surface has no field to restrict which sub-option/command word a spell may use when cast. Without this, the encoding implies the wand can issue any Command, which is incorrect.
